Which statements describe an environmental challenge caused by the disposal of plastics?
1
The burning of the plastics can release toxic gases.
2
Plastics are harmful to marine life.
3
Plastics decompose very slowly in the environment.
A
1, 2 and 3
B
1 and 2 only
C
1 and 3 only
D
2 and 3 only
subject: Chemistry
